pillar: 6 — Paid media / performance marketing (creative production with pillar 15)
intents: I need ten fresh ads this week and I have no designer
make me static / image ads for Meta, Instagram, TikTok or LinkedIn
my ads all look the same — I need different concepts
more like my winning ad — new hooks
same image with different text or another font
my image ad got rejected — fix it
the price or stock changed on ads already running
a header image or social graphic in our brand style
reads: brand brain: core rules and facts with their statuses (confirmed / found / guess / unknown) and sources — brand_knowledge_browse, brand_knowledge_search, brand_knowledge_read (server research and the claims-gate sign-off write them)
brand kit, learnings incl. do/dont/must rules, products and competitors — brand_read (server research)
the brand's recent organic posts and what drew replies — brand_read organic (server research)
approved campaign record, read as input only: brief (Status: Approved), concepts — plan-campaign (campaign_read)
weekly performance read: reports/performance/<date>.md ('what to make next') — analyze-performance

request lines 'Rotation needed: for make-static-ads' / 'Fix needed: for make-static-ads' in ads/campaigns/<slug>/rotation-requests.md, and the health line of ads/campaigns/<slug>/state.md — run-paid-campaigns

own and competitor Meta ads — ads_template_read mine / competitor, imported with ads_library_scrape (server research); category leaders' live Ad Library pages (host browser, or the data proxy on a yes); the template library and community templates
kept product photos — the marketer, or the goose-product-photos skill

graphic request lines 'Graphic needed: for make-static-ads · …' in lifecycle/flows/<flow-slug>.md (email-lifecycle), social/calendar/<start-date>.md (run-organic-social), content/repurposed/<source-slug>/<date>.md and content/drafts/<date>-<slug>.md (make-content)
the brand's own live ads in the Meta Ad Library and in the library of each other platform it advertises on (LinkedIn, TikTok, Google; host browser, or the data proxy on a yes)
run-memory: previous run and open recommendation outcomes at start; missing first run is explicit
writes: lower-case creative tags (concept, style, angle, type, level, template, batch, mode, test, offer-ends, claims, judge:*, try:*, superseded, picked) — read by analyze-performance and research-competitors
the human's picks and verdicts: feedback in the human's words (rating happy only on their pick) + 'picked' tag + the batch file — read by run-paid-campaigns and the brand's learned rules

batch file ads/batches/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>.md: the concept board (what was read, level, each row's angle, message and source, visual idea, on-image text, template, protected choice, critic notes), per-ad copy (primary A/B, headline, description, CTA, destination), creative and render ids per ratio, font, palette, logo, the final prompt and image list per ratio, the judge result per try, copy variants, claims and policy lines, special-category flag, picks, cut list, flags — run-paid-campaigns launches from it verbatim
'Rotation ready:' / 'Fix ready:' answers under run-paid-campaigns' request lines — read by run-paid-campaigns on its next run
'Graphic ready:' answer lines under sibling request lines — read by email-lifecycle, run-organic-social, make-content on their next run
brand learnings through the shared save-learning atom, on the human's own words (incl. claims the marketer confirms in chat) — read by every creative playbook
ad-library charges in research/credits-log/<YYYY-MM>.md (spend-gate branch B) — read by every playbook that estimates proxy spend
board.md: the concept board, shown to the marketer with the quotes
profile.md: the brand profile (positioning, angles it uses, how its ads look and read, what it never does), shown with the board
logo-placed versions of each render (media_upload + ads_save with the render as parent) — the version the marketer receives
